name: 色带检测
description: 检测 posterization and quantization 伪影 in smooth 梯度s. AI images may show subtle color banding due to limited color depth in generated content.
algorithm: Gradient Step Detection + Banding Ratio Analysis
mechanism: 分析 smooth 梯度 regions for discrete color steps 通过比较 adjacent pixel differences. Banding indicates quantization from AI generation or heavy compression.
parameters: Step 检测 阈值: 2, Gradient range: 3-40, Window: 5 pixels
useCase: Detecting color quantization 伪影 in AI生成的 images

references.title: Wang, Z. et al. (2004). Image Quality Assessment: From Error Visibility to Structural Similarity. IEEE TIP.
Daly, S. (1992). Visible Differences Predictor. SPIE Human Vision.
Lee, S. & Bovik, A.C. (2002). Fast Algorithms for Signal and Image Processing. IEEE TSP.

strengths:
• Effective at detecting posterization and quantization 伪影
• Reveals bit-depth reduction from processing
• Complementary to 梯度 and 直方图 methods
• Works 跨 all image formats
• Low computational cost
limitations:
• Natural smooth 梯度s may trigger 误报
• Display calibration affects visual verification
• Less effective on high-bit-depth images (16-bit)
• Heavy dithering can mask banding 伪影
• Subtle banding may be below 检测 阈值
